tool_args.rationale: All five paid rows are short-horizon observations (H=0.16–0.48), while the forecast target is H=21.1. They cannot constrain the slow timescale or verify the candidate sign reversal. A slow-horizon discriminating probe is therefore needed before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a dual-horizon adaptation model from the five short-H rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These observations establish short-window positive gain but cannot identify the slow adaptation term or establish reversal at the target H=21.1.
A fine trajectory batch is less directly informative than a long-horizon observation for distinguishing the candidate reversal mechanisms.
The provided rows have x_now=0 and only short horizons, so they do not identify a periodic contribution; the retrieved mechanism notes instead point to endogenous dual-horizon adaptation.
